purpose: Measure whether versioned Gemini Code Cards improve retrieval for a pinned, fully indexed Starlette snapshot. The 50 cases balance middleware, request/response, routing, WebSocket, concurrency, static files, authentication, templating, forms, and exception handling. Each case records the expected implementation definition; documentation or test chunks may appear above it and are reported separately.

cases.query: Where does Starlette reject a streaming HTTP request body after it exceeds the configured size limit?
cases.intent: Behavioral question; avoids the implementation identifier and distinguishes an incremental body-size check from a simple Content-Length check.

cases.query: Wie führt Starlette mehrere Hintergrundaufgaben nacheinander aus, nachdem eine Response gesendet wurde?
cases.intent: German behavioral wording; expects execution semantics rather than the class name.

cases.query: How can a request handler detect whether the HTTP client disconnected without waiting for a full request body?
cases.intent: Conceptual async-server question with no target identifier.

cases.query: Which Starlette implementation parses a Range header to serve a byte interval from a file response?
cases.intent: HTTP behavior and internal responsibility rather than an exact method-name query.

cases.query: Wo wird eine CORS Preflight OPTIONS-Anfrage beantwortet und die erlaubten Header erzeugt?
cases.intent: German framework question; may have strong lexical evidence, so it is a control case as well as a semantic case.

cases.query: How does static-file serving decide that a browser cache validator means the file has not changed?
cases.intent: Describes conditional caching semantics without using ETag or method names.

cases.query: Welche Middleware schreibt nach erfolgreicher Authentifizierung Benutzer und Berechtigungen in den ASGI Scope?
cases.intent: German data-flow question, targeting authenticated scope population.

cases.query: Where is state returned by an application lifespan context copied into the ASGI scope during startup?
cases.intent: Lifecycle behavior, not router-name lookup.

cases.query: Which middleware rejects requests whose Host header is not in an allowed host list?
cases.intent: Security behavior; target is an implementation definition, not documentation.

cases.query: Wie erzwingt der Multipart-Parser die maximale Zahl hochgeladener Dateien in einer Anfrage?
cases.intent: German parser-limit question with terminology that differs from the method name.

cases.query: How is an ordinary HTTP denial response adapted so it can be sent while handling a WebSocket connection?
cases.intent: Protocol-adaptation behavior without source identifiers.

cases.query: Welche Funktion iteriert synchronen Code schrittweise in einem Threadpool, damit er asynchron konsumiert werden kann?
cases.intent: German concurrency behavior; likely benefits from semantically descriptive card text.

cases.query: Where does Starlette decide whether an HTTP response should use gzip based on the request's accepted encodings?
cases.intent: Middleware negotiation behavior; distinguishes responder selection from the compression algorithm itself.

cases.query: Wie passt Starlette bei komprimierten Streaming-Responses Content-Encoding, Content-Length und Vary an?
cases.intent: German middleware question targeting delayed header emission and streaming compression bookkeeping.

cases.query: How are signed cookie sessions loaded into the connection scope and written back only when accessed or modified?
cases.intent: Session middleware data-flow question covering signature validation, scope population, and response cookies.

cases.query: Wo werden unsichere HTTP- und WebSocket-Verbindungen auf HTTPS beziehungsweise WSS umgeleitet?
cases.intent: German middleware behavior; expects scheme conversion and default-port normalization.

cases.query: How does Starlette expose request-body chunks while preventing the incoming stream from being consumed twice?
cases.intent: Request streaming semantics without naming the implementation method.

cases.query: Where are Content-Length and a text media type's charset automatically added to an outgoing response?
cases.intent: Response construction behavior; distinguishes automatic headers from later mutable-header access.

cases.query: Which response logic serializes cookie attributes such as SameSite, HttpOnly, Secure, expiry, and partitioning?
cases.intent: Cookie serialization question phrased through supported attributes rather than the method identifier.

cases.query: How does a streaming response handle client disconnects differently for older and newer ASGI specification versions?
cases.intent: Protocol-version behavior involving task-group cancellation versus send failures.

cases.query: Wo sendet eine Datei-Response mehrere angeforderte Bytebereiche als multipart/byteranges mit Boundary?
cases.intent: German response question targeting transmission of multiple ranges rather than header parsing.

cases.query: Which routing code turns typed path parameters into a regular expression, a reverse-format string, and converters?
cases.intent: Route-pattern construction question that avoids the function name.

cases.query: Wie werden Parameter beim Reverse Routing mithilfe ihrer Konverter in einen URL-Pfad eingesetzt?
cases.intent: German reverse-routing behavior focused on converter serialization and consumed parameters.

cases.query: Where does an HTTP route report a partial match when the path fits but the request method is not allowed?
cases.intent: Routing classification question distinguishing path matching from 405 response handling.

cases.query: How does reverse URL lookup traverse a named mounted application and prepend its path prefix?
cases.intent: Nested routing question involving mount-name prefixes and delegation to child routes.

cases.query: Wo prüft der Router eine alternative URL mit hinzugefügtem oder entferntem Schrägstrich und sendet dann einen Redirect?
cases.intent: German routing fallback question targeting slash normalization after full and partial matching fail.

cases.query: How does Starlette accept a WebSocket when the initial connection event has not yet been received?
cases.intent: WebSocket handshake sequencing without using the target's qualified identifier.

cases.query: Where is incoming WebSocket JSON decoded from either a text frame or UTF-8 binary frame?
cases.intent: WebSocket payload decoding question that distinguishes low-level convenience handling from endpoint dispatch.

cases.query: Welche asynchrone Iteration über WebSocket-Textnachrichten endet still, sobald die Gegenstelle trennt?
cases.intent: German WebSocket iteration behavior focused on disconnect suppression.

cases.query: Which implementation validates outgoing WebSocket ASGI message types and updates connection state after accept, close, or denial-response events?
cases.intent: WebSocket state-machine question rather than a simple frame-sending lookup.

cases.query: Wo erzwingt ein klassenbasierter WebSocket-Endpunkt sein konfiguriertes Text-, Bytes- oder JSON-Format und schließt bei falschen Daten?
cases.intent: German class-based endpoint question targeting encoding validation and malformed-data closure.

cases.query: How can Starlette execute a synchronous callable with positional and keyword arguments without blocking the event loop?
cases.intent: Concurrency question describing worker-thread delegation without copying the function identifier.

cases.query: Welche Hilfsfunktion startet mehrere Coroutinen gleichzeitig und bricht die übrigen ab, sobald die erste fertig ist?
cases.intent: German concurrency semantics targeting first-completion cancellation.

cases.query: Where is iterator exhaustion translated to a custom exception so it can safely cross a worker-thread boundary?
cases.intent: Internal concurrency behavior distinguishing exhaustion translation from asynchronous iteration.

cases.query: How does static-file serving resolve directory index pages, canonicalize missing trailing slashes, and fall back to a custom 404 page?
cases.intent: Static HTML-mode behavior covering its response-selection workflow.

cases.query: Wo wird verhindert, dass absolute Pfade, übergeordnete Verzeichnisse oder Symlinks aus einem freigegebenen Static-Verzeichnis ausbrechen?
cases.intent: German static-file security question targeting filesystem containment checks.

cases.query: Which code resolves static asset directories supplied either directly or through installed Python packages?
cases.intent: Static configuration question distinguishing directory discovery from request-time lookup.

cases.query: Where is the one-time asynchronous check that the configured static path exists and is a directory or symbolic link?
cases.intent: Static-file startup validation rather than missing-file request handling.

cases.query: How does Starlette protect HTTP and WebSocket endpoints by required permission scopes, including optional login redirects?
cases.intent: Authentication authorization flow across synchronous, asynchronous, and WebSocket endpoints.

cases.query: Welche Prüfung stellt sicher, dass jede geforderte Berechtigung in den Anmeldedaten einer Verbindung vorhanden ist?
cases.intent: German authorization predicate question emphasizing all-scope semantics.

cases.query: Where is an authentication backend failure converted by default into a plain-text HTTP 400 response?
cases.intent: Authentication error fallback distinct from middleware scope population.

cases.query: How are request-aware context processors merged before a Jinja template is rendered into an HTML response?
cases.intent: Template response construction focused on context assembly and rendering.

cases.query: Wo sendet eine Template-Response vor dem eigentlichen HTTP-Ergebnis zusätzliche Debug-Informationen über Vorlage und Kontext?
cases.intent: German templating question targeting the ASGI debug extension behavior.

cases.query: Which setup code injects a request-aware reverse-URL helper into the Jinja environment without overwriting an existing global?
cases.intent: Template environment configuration involving route URL generation.

cases.query: How are streamed application/x-www-form-urlencoded fields accumulated, percent-decoded, and returned as form data?
cases.intent: Form parsing question distinguishing URL-encoded fields from multipart uploads.

cases.query: Wo werden Multipart-Upload-Blöcke asynchron in temporäre Dateien geschrieben, zurückgespult und bei Fehlern geschlossen?
cases.intent: German multipart lifecycle question covering nonblocking writes and cleanup.

cases.query: Which callback counts completed URL-encoded form fields and rejects the request after the configured maximum?
cases.intent: Form-limit behavior distinct from the existing multipart uploaded-file cap.

cases.query: How does Starlette choose a registered handler for an exception by walking its class inheritance hierarchy?
cases.intent: Exception dispatch question focused on superclass fallback.

cases.query: Where does Starlette reject handling an exception after response headers were already sent and run synchronous handlers in a worker thread?
cases.intent: Exception-wrapper behavior combining response-start safety with sync-handler execution.

cases.query: Wie entscheidet die Serverfehler-Behandlung anhand des Accept-Headers zwischen einer HTML-Traceback-Seite und reinem Text?
cases.intent: German exception-handling question targeting debug response content negotiation.
